sourceText:
Pizza Patties
By: Anonymous
Published: Friday, December 4, 2009 - 11:16pm

Ingredients




1 beaten egg
1 (10 ½ oz.) can pizza sauce
 cup fine dry bread crumbs
2 teaspoons instant minced onion
1/2 teaspoon dried oregano, crushed
1/4 teaspoon salt
Dash of pepper
1 1/2 pounds ground beef or ground turkey
3 slices Mozzarella cheese, cut in half

Preparation

1 Preheat broiler. In mixing bow combine egg, 1/3 cup of the pizza sauce, bread crumbs, instant minced onion, oregano, salt, and pepper. Add beef; mix well. Shape mixture into 6 patties. Broil 3-4 inches from heat for 15 minutes, turning once and brushing frequently with pizza sauce. Top each patty with half slice cheese. Broil until cheese melts. Heat and pass remaining pizza sauce.
